types.name: MarketCreated
docs: Emitted when a new strike market is created.

types.name: MarketSettled
docs: Emitted when a market is settled (either by oracle or admin).

types.name: MeridianConfig
docs: Global program configuration. Singleton PDA seeded by `["config"]`.

fields.name: admin
docs: The admin authority who can manage tickers, pause, and force-settle.

fields.name: paused
docs: Whether the program is paused (blocks minting and market creation).

fields.name: staleness_threshold
docs: Maximum age (seconds) an oracle price can be before it is rejected.

fields.name: confidence_threshold_bps
docs: Maximum oracle confidence interval in basis points.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed for the config account.

types.name: PairMinted
docs: Emitted when a user mints a Yes/No token pair.

types.name: StrikeMarket
docs: A binary-option strike market. PDA seeded by

fields.name: ticker
docs: Ticker symbol this market is for (max 10 chars).

fields.name: trading_date
docs: Trading date as Unix timestamp of midnight ET.

fields.name: yes_mint
docs: SPL token mint for YES outcome tokens (PDA).

fields.name: no_mint
docs: SPL token mint for NO outcome tokens (PDA).

fields.name: vault
docs: USDC vault holding collateral for minted pairs (PDA ATA).

fields.name: phoenix_market
docs: Phoenix Legacy market address for this strike.

fields.name: total_pairs_minted
docs: Total number of Yes/No token pairs minted.

fields.name: total_pairs_redeemed
docs: Total number of Yes/No token pairs redeemed (burned for USDC).

fields.name: settled
docs: Whether this market has been settled.

fields.name: outcome_yes_wins
docs: If settled, whether YES wins (price >= strike).

fields.name: settled_at
docs: Unix timestamp when the market was settled (0 if not yet settled).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed for the market account.

types.name: TickerConfig
docs: Per-ticker configuration. PDA seeded by `["ticker", symbol_bytes]`.

fields.name: pyth_feed_id
docs: The Pyth price-feed account for this ticker.

fields.name: active
docs: Whether this ticker is currently active for new markets.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed for the ticker account.

types.name: TokensRedeemed
docs: Emitted when a user redeems tokens after settlement.
